verdict.rationale: Inngest ships an official CLI documented at /docs/cli that lets users inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents access to Inngest data from the terminal — explicitly framed for AI-native/agentic workflows; a runtime probe confirms it installs and runs via npx (inngest-cli@latest v1.44.0). This is corroborated by both docs and an independent runtime check, though there's no third-party community review specifically of the CLI's agentic features (missing for 10: independent/community validation of the CLI's AI-agent-facing features specifically).
